status: fixed before candidate fitting; retrospective exploratory study of already viewed attachments
curved: u_min=log(0.1); delta_min=delta-2*kappa*u_min; both delta and delta_min in [0,5*beta]
curved_constraint_rationale: Extend the original 0<=gamma<=5 bound to the local quality-token elasticity on the entire declared Q support. The constant-power family is nested exactly.
fitting: bounded variable projection of E,A,B; analytic profiled derivatives; SLSQP with linear constraints in alpha,beta,delta,delta_min; multiple predetermined starts
B1: reproduce classical fit and leave-one-full-model-size-out validation; do not pool B1 and B6 exponents
nested_validation: For each of the 8 Q-level outer folds and each of the 45 N-D-cell outer folds, select using two inner protocols: leave-one-training-Q-level-out and deterministic 5-fold complete-training-cell validation. Fits and starts use only inner training rows. Apply the promotion rule to inner predictions; refit the chosen model on outer training rows.
primary_metric: pooled RMSE in original Loss units; also record MAE, macro group RMSE, and per-group wins
promotion_rule: Curved must improve pooled RMSE by at least 1% in BOTH primary group protocols, win strictly more than half of the groups in each, and reduce RMSE for the nested selection procedure versus the power-only procedure in BOTH outer protocols. Otherwise retain power. Group-resampling ranges are descriptive, not formal significance tests.
inner_rule: Curved must improve RMSE by at least 1% in both inner group protocols and win strictly more than half the groups in each. No outer validation losses may enter the decision.
B7: exclude exact B6 experiment IDs; only new Q levels; historical same-source extension, no tuning or selection
B8: audit quality direction and metadata only; no fit or pooling with B6 without a calibrated shared quality scale
robust_loss: not an initial candidate; consider separately only if top 10% of N-D cells contribute more than 50% of squared residuals or a cell supplies more than 20%; any extra candidate requires a new protocol version
uncertainty: 200 paired whole-N-D-cell bootstrap draws; preserve joint parameter rows, marginal and finite quality-substitution scenarios; do not combine independent parameter interval endpoints
outputs: isolated theory_v26 directory; existing Q2, Q3, Q4 and v25 manuscript are frozen; output an explicit versioned handoff without updating downstream consumers
